shared: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE ancient Chinese tactical equipment inventory icon. First reference is the FULL ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT ATLAS: use it only for historical object vocabulary, not its detailed surface style or grid arrangement. Second reference is approved broad-matte STYLE ONLY: thick dark outline, exaggerated chunky silhouette, huge calm uninterrupted painted planes and two broad light/shadow tones per material. Native destination 48x48, so simplify aggressively. No stipple, mottling, mosaic, scratches, grain, glossy rendering, gradients, tiny ornamental lines or glitter. Oblique three-quarter overhead game view. One compact group centered in a square canvas, about 80 percent fill, full objects with clear margins. Genuine transparent alpha outside and through gaps. No background, ground, cast shadow, checkerboard, text, labels, UI frame or characters. Do not reproduce atlas.

assets.subject: Subject: 游骑主装备组, light roaming cavalry kit: ONE plain brown leather saddle with exaggerated deep seat and one simple iron stirrup, ONE short gently curved Chinese dao saber diagonally behind it. Reference atlas saddle row2 col2 and saber row1 col2. No horse, armor, helmet or ornate decoration. Muted ochre leather, slate iron, dark red grip. Simplify to two interlocking large objects; plain broad saddle panels.
assets.identity: Role reconstruction using atlas saddle row2 col2 and dao row1 col2; legacy runtime crossbow is mismatched.

assets.subject: Subject: 炮石营主装备组, ancient Chinese stone-throwing artillery crew kit: a large thick brown leather catapult sling pouch cupping ONE oversized angular gray stone, with two short thick tan rope loops folded close beside it, and ONE additional angular stone at its base. Atlas third row third wooden stone-thrower establishes sling artillery identity. Show portable ammunition and sling kit, not entire siege engine. Chunky massive shapes, each stone only two broad matte gray planes. No cannon, gunpowder, lettering or tiny woven texture.
assets.identity: Role reconstruction from stone-thrower atlas row3 col3, portable sling and stone ammunition; legacy runtime pick is mismatched.

assets.subject: Subject: 地道营主装备组, ancient Chinese tunneling crew tool kit: ONE stout wood-handled dark iron pickaxe crossed diagonally with ONE short broad rectangular iron spade, a thick tan binding rope at their intersection. Reference atlas bottom row first mining tool group. Exaggerated large pick and shovel heads, compact short handles, two large uninterrupted iron planes, smooth ochre wood with no grain. No helmet, person, shovel of modern plastic or extra objects.
assets.identity: Role reconstruction from mining tools atlas row6 col1; legacy runtime helmet is mismatched.

assets.subject: Subject: 互市护卫主装备组, ancient Chinese market caravan escort kit: ONE plain round wooden shield with dull iron rim and large central iron boss behind ONE compact brown leather travel satchel with closed broad flap, simple large buckle and short folded strap. Atlas row1 col5 plain round shield and bottom-row travel bag vocabulary. Two-object compact grouping, no sword, ornate gold, face emblem, coins or writing. Shield wood is just three broad plank planes without grain; satchel only two broad leather tones.
assets.identity: Role reconstruction from plain shield atlas row1 col5 and travel supplies row6; legacy command tablet mismatch documented by earlier remake.
